metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Remaining Properties Audit Checklist (Stage 2 - Batch 4)
metadata.description: Partial checklist for non-boundary properties. This batch covers adaptor operations, bridge flows, Nova proof generation, emergency controls, and wrap/unwrap edge transitions.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-JOB-FAILED provides error details for proof conversion failures
checklist.description: Verify that when proof conversion fails, the system transitions to STATE-JOB-FAILED with descriptive error information enabling user retry.
detection_procedure: 1. Identify the job failure path in the decider-prover service
2. Verify error details are captured and stored in job state
3. Confirm failure events are emitted with error context
4. Test proof conversion with invalid IVC input
5. Verify error message is accessible to client for retry decision

executable_checks.command: Review decider-prover error handling for job failures
executable_checks.assertion: Job failure state includes error description

executable_checks.command: Submit malformed IVC proof and verify error response
executable_checks.assertion: Error response contains actionable failure reason

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-061-STATE-JOB-FAILED -> Node STATE-JOB-FAILED. Failure state is informational for user retry. Important for UX but not security-critical.

checklist.title: Verify Adaptor is stateless and ready for bridge requests
checklist.description: Verify that the Adaptor contract maintains no blocking state between calls and is always ready to process new bridge requests.
detection_procedure: 1. Review Adaptor contract for persistent state variables
2. Verify no storage modifications that could block future calls
3. Confirm each call is independent with no cross-call dependencies
4. Check for absence of reentrancy locks that could deadlock
5. Verify no pausing mechanism that could block operations indefinitely

executable_checks.assertion: No blocking state variables exist
Multiple sequential calls succeed without state interference

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-062-STATE-ADAPTOR-IDLE -> Node STATE-ADAPTOR-IDLE. Adaptor is stateless per-call. Reachability: UNREACHABLE - no blocking mechanism.

checklist.title: Verify bridge request validation including slippage limits
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-ADAPTOR-RECEIVE-UNWRAP-BRIDGE validates all bridge parameters including slippage limits before processing.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate bridge request handling in Adaptor contract
2. Verify slippage parameter validation (minAmountOut > 0)
3. Check destination chain validation against supported chains
4. Verify recipient address validation (non-zero)
5. Confirm invalid parameters cause revert before external calls

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid bridge parameters revert with descriptive error

executable_checks.command: Review parameter validation before Stargate.send() call
executable_checks.assertion: All parameters validated before external interaction

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-063-ACTION-ADAPTOR-RECEIVE-UNWRAP-BRIDGE -> Node ACTION-ADAPTOR-RECEIVE-UNWRAP-BRIDGE. Parameter validation prevents invalid bridge operations.

checklist.title: Verify Adaptor correctly invokes LiquidityManager for unwrap
checklist.description: Verify that the Adaptor delegates unwrap operations to LiquidityManager and does not bypass the authorized unwrap flow.
detection_procedure: 1. Trace unwrap path in Adaptor contract
2. Verify Adaptor calls LiquidityManager.unwrap()
3. Confirm no direct token transfer bypassing LiquidityManager
4. Check Adaptor does not hold underlying tokens after operation
5. Verify proper authorization of Adaptor in LiquidityManager

executable_checks.assertion: All unwrap paths go through LiquidityManager
Adaptor unwrap triggers LiquidityManager.unwrap()

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-064-ACTION-ADAPTOR-UNWRAP-VIA-LM -> Node ACTION-ADAPTOR-UNWRAP-VIA-LM. CRITICAL: Adaptor must not bypass LiquidityManager authorization.

checklist.title: Verify Stargate bridge enforces minAmountOut slippage protection
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-ADAPTOR-BRIDGE-VIA-STARGATE passes minAmountOut to Stargate for slippage protection during cross-chain transfers.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Stargate.send() call in Adaptor
2. Verify minAmountOut parameter is passed correctly
3. Confirm minAmountOut is user-specified, not hardcoded to 0
4. Check slippage calculation logic if derived on-chain
5. Test that Stargate reverts when slippage exceeds limit

executable_checks.assertion: Bridge reverts when output < minAmountOut

executable_checks.command: Verify minAmountOut is not hardcoded to 0
executable_checks.assertion: User controls slippage tolerance

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-065-ACTION-ADAPTOR-BRIDGE-VIA-STARGATE -> Node ACTION-ADAPTOR-BRIDGE-VIA-STARGATE. Slippage protection is critical for cross-chain value preservation.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED implies prior unwrap completion
checklist.description: Verify that STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED can only be reached after successful unwrap via LiquidityManager, ensuring correct sequencing.
detection_procedure: 1. Trace execution path to bridge initiation
2. Verify unwrap occurs before Stargate.send()
3. Confirm no path initiates bridge without unwrap
4. Check for reentrancy that could skip unwrap step
5. Verify transaction atomicity (unwrap + bridge in same tx)

executable_checks.assertion: Bridge cannot be called without prior unwrap
No reentrancy allows skipping unwrap

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-066-STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED -> Node STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED. Sequential execution ensures unwrap before bridge. Atomic transaction guarantees ordering.

checklist.title: Verify bridge failure keeps user funds safe
checklist.description: Verify that STATE-BRIDGE-FAILED indicates bridge operation failure without loss of user funds.
detection_procedure: 1. Identify bridge failure scenarios (Stargate reverts)
2. Verify entire transaction reverts on bridge failure
3. Confirm unwrapped tokens return to user on failure
4. Check for partial execution states that could trap funds
5. Test Stargate failure simulation and fund recovery

executable_checks.assertion: Bridge failure reverts entire transaction, no fund loss

executable_checks.command: Review Stargate error handling in Adaptor
executable_checks.assertion: Failed bridge reverts atomically

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-067-STATE-BRIDGE-FAILED -> Node STATE-BRIDGE-FAILED. CRITICAL: Bridge failure must not result in fund loss. Operator responsibility for Stargate recovery.

checklist.title: Verify stealth address generation is cryptographically secure
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-USER-GENERATE-STEALTH produces cryptographically secure stealth addresses from user secrets using keccak256 and Poseidon hashing.
detection_procedure: 1. Review stealth address derivation algorithm
2. Verify keccak256 used for PoW validation
3. Confirm Poseidon hash used for address binding
4. Check sufficient entropy in secret generation
5. Verify stealth address unpredictable without secret

executable_checks.command: Review stealth address derivation in SDK
executable_checks.assertion: Derivation uses keccak256 + Poseidon with user secret
Different secrets produce different addresses

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-068-ACTION-USER-GENERATE-STEALTH -> Node ACTION-USER-GENERATE-STEALTH. CRITICAL: Stealth address security depends on hash function properties and secret entropy.

checklist.title: Verify Nova IVC proof generation validates secret-to-address binding
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-USER-GENERATE-NOVA-PROOF generates valid IVC proofs only for transfers belonging to addresses derived from the user's secret.
detection_procedure: 1. Review Nova circuit constraints for secret-to-address binding
2. Verify compute_burn_address_from_secret() implementation
3. Confirm circuit rejects proofs for non-owned transfers
4. Test proof generation with wrong secret
5. Verify IVC proof cannot be forged without correct secret

executable_checks.command: Review Nova circuit secret binding constraints
executable_checks.assertion: Circuit enforces secret-to-address binding

executable_checks.command: Attempt proof generation for non-owned transfers
executable_checks.assertion: Proof generation fails for non-owned transfers

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-069-ACTION-USER-GENERATE-NOVA-PROOF -> Node ACTION-USER-GENERATE-NOVA-PROOF. CRITICAL: IVC soundness ensures only secret holders can generate valid proofs.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-HAS-NOVA-PROOF implies valid IVC proof ownership
checklist.description: Verify that STATE-USER-HAS-NOVA-PROOF indicates the user holds a valid IVC proof for their claimed transfers, validated during generation.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify IVC proof validity checked during generation
2. Confirm proof references correct transfer history
3. Check on-chain verification rejects invalid proofs
4. Verify proof cannot be transferred to non-owners
5. Test submission of proof for different user's transfers

executable_checks.assertion: Generated proof encodes user's secret binding

executable_checks.command: Submit proof for non-owned transfers on-chain
executable_checks.assertion: On-chain verification rejects mismatched proofs

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-070-STATE-USER-HAS-NOVA-PROOF -> Node STATE-USER-HAS-NOVA-PROOF. CRITICAL: IVC proof possession state implies verified ownership.

checklist.title: Verify verifier rotation restricted to owner during emergency
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-VERIFIER-ROTATE-VERIFIERS can only be called by owner and only during emergency state.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify onlyOwner modifier on rotateVerifiers()
2. Confirm emergency state check before rotation
3. Test rotation call by non-owner (should revert)
4. Test rotation call outside emergency (should revert)
5. Verify rotation parameters validated

executable_checks.assertion: Only owner can rotate, only during emergency
No unprotected verifier rotation paths

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-071-VERIFIER-ROTATE -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-ROTATE-VERIFIERS. OUT_OF_SCOPE per trust model: owner operations trusted.

checklist.title: Verify emergency deactivation requires prior verifier rotation
checklist.description: Verify that ACTION-VERIFIER-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY can only be called by owner after verifier rotation is complete.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify onlyOwner modifier on deactivateEmergency()
2. Confirm verifier rotation state check before deactivation
3. Test deactivation without prior rotation (should revert)
4. Verify emergency flag properly cleared after deactivation
5. Test sequence: trigger emergency -> rotate -> deactivate

executable_checks.assertion: Deactivation requires owner + prior rotation
Proper sequencing enforced

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-072-EMERGENCY-DEACTIVATE -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY. OUT_OF_SCOPE per trust model: owner operations trusted.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED implies new verifiers active
checklist.description: Verify that STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED indicates new verifiers are active and emergency flag is cleared.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify emergency flag cleared in recovery state
2. Confirm new verifier addresses are stored and active
3. Check old verifiers are no longer authorized
4. Test proof verification with old verifiers (should fail)
5. Verify normal operations resume after recovery

executable_checks.assertion: Post-recovery: new verifiers active, emergency flag false
All recovery invariants maintained

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-073-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED -> Node STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED. OUT_OF_SCOPE per trust model: owner operations trusted.

checklist.title: Verify reward calculation uses correct IncentiveLib parameters
checklist.description: Verify that EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-REWARD transition invokes IncentiveLib with correct liquidity and curve parameters read atomically.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate reward calculation in LiquidityManager.wrap()
2. Verify IncentiveLib.computeIncentive() receives correct params
3. Confirm parameters read from storage atomically
4. Check no external call between param read and calculation
5. Test reward calculation matches expected curve output

executable_checks.assertion: Reward matches IncentiveLib with current state

executable_checks.command: Verify atomic parameter read in computeIncentive
executable_checks.assertion: No TOCTOU vulnerability in reward calculation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-002-LM-CALCULATES-REWARD -> Edge EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-REWARD. Parameters cannot be modified mid-transaction.

checklist.title: Verify SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom used for token pulls
checklist.description: Verify that EDGE-LM-PULLS-LIQUIDITY uses SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom for secure token transfer with proper revert on failure.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate token transfer in LiquidityManager.wrap()
2. Verify SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom is used
3. Confirm using SafeERC20 library correctly imported
4. Test with non-standard ERC20 (no return value)
5. Verify transfer failure reverts entire transaction

executable_checks.assertion: No unchecked token transfers
Non-standard tokens handled correctly

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-003-LM-PULLS-LIQUIDITY -> Edge EDGE-LM-PULLS-LIQUIDITY. SafeERC20 handles non-standard ERC20 return values.

checklist.title: Verify minting exact (amount + reward) to user
checklist.description: Verify that EDGE-LM-MINTS-ZERC20 mints exactly the calculated (amount + reward) to the user's address.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate mint call in LiquidityManager.wrap()
2. Verify mint amount equals input amount + computed reward
3. Confirm recipient is the user address, not contract
4. Check for rounding errors in sum calculation
5. Test mint amount matches expected total

executable_checks.assertion: Minted amount = deposit + reward exactly
Exact amount minted to correct recipient

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-004-LM-MINTS-ZERC20 -> Edge EDGE-LM-MINTS-ZERC20. CRITICAL: Mint amount computed atomically from wrap amount + IncentiveLib reward.

checklist.title: Verify Wrapped event emitted with accurate parameters
checklist.description: Verify that EDGE-WRAP-COMPLETE emits Wrapped event with accurate parameters reflecting the actual wrap operation.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Wrapped event emission in wrap()
2. Verify event parameters match transaction values
3. Confirm user address, amount, reward accurately recorded
4. Check event emitted after state changes
5. Test event parameters against actual state changes

executable_checks.assertion: Event parameters match actual wrap values

executable_checks.command: Verify event emission placement and params
executable_checks.assertion: Event reflects actual operation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-005-WRAP-COMPLETE -> Edge EDGE-WRAP-COMPLETE. Event parameters populated from transaction state.

checklist.title: Verify user balance increased by minted amount
checklist.description: Verify that EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20 correctly increases user's zERC20 balance by the minted amount.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify ERC20._mint atomically updates balance
2. Confirm no path bypasses balance update
3. Check balanceOf(user) increases by exact mint amount
4. Test balance consistency before and after wrap
5. Verify totalSupply increases by mint amount

executable_checks.assertion: User balance increases by exact minted amount
OpenZeppelin _mint ensures atomic balance update

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-006-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20 -> Edge EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20. ERC20._mint atomically updates balance. No bypass path.

checklist.title: Verify fee calculation uses ceiling division
checklist.description: Verify that EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-FEE uses ceiling division for fee calculation to prevent protocol loss from fee underpayment.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate fee calculation in IncentiveLib.computeFee()
2. Verify ceiling division formula: (a + b - 1) / b
3. Confirm no floor division for fee calculation
4. Test edge cases with small amounts
5. Verify fee >= theoretical percentage

executable_checks.assertion: Fee uses ceiling division, never underpays
Explicit ceiling division implemented

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-008-LM-CALCULATES-FEE -> Edge EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-FEE. IncentiveLib implements ceiling division for protocol protection.

checklist.title: Verify exact unwrap amount burned from user
checklist.description: Verify that EDGE-LM-BURNS-ZERC20 burns exactly the requested unwrap amount from user's balance.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate burn call in LiquidityManager.unwrap()
2. Verify burn amount equals input unwrap amount
3. Confirm burn from user's address, not contract
4. Check balance decreases by exact burn amount
5. Test burn amount matches requested unwrap

executable_checks.assertion: Burn amount = unwrap request amount exactly

executable_checks.command: Verify burn(user, amount) call in unwrap
executable_checks.assertion: Exact amount burned from correct account

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-009-LM-BURNS-ZERC20 -> Edge EDGE-LM-BURNS-ZERC20. CRITICAL: Burn amount equals input parameter. Atomic operation.
